summary: This table presents variations on the Transformer architecture, specifically focusing on metrics related to English-to-German translation performance, as evaluated on the newstest2013 dataset. It includes configurations with different model parameters such as the number of layers, attention heads, and dimensions for key and value vectors. Key metrics displayed include perplexity (PPL) and BLEU scores across various configurations, highlighting the impact of model size and dropout rates on translation quality. Notably, the results suggest that larger models generally yield better performance, while careful tuning of dropout rates is essential to avoid overfitting.
